brandMarks.reason: Lucide ships no brand icons; currentColor requires inline SVG

mediaMeta.restFilterNote: Compresses luminance toward the ramp's own L 0.78. sRGB has no bright-and-saturated colour, so under mix-blend-mode: color the spec's ClipColor desaturates highlights toward grey - at full range a white shirt kept only ~5% of the ramp's chroma and clipped to a flat patch. Raising contrast here reintroduces the posterisation.
mediaMeta.activeSelection: most visible tile of any kind, image or video

tintOverlay.note: color takes hue/saturation from the overlay and luminance from the frame, so the desaturated image is recoloured along the ramp rather than washed over. Requires full desaturation first.

playback.hover: decided per event from pointerType; only pointerType === 'touch' is excluded
playback.focus: never gated - keyboard reveal must work on every device
playback.scrollingWidths: below --breakpoint-content an IntersectionObserver picks the most-visible tile, one video at a time; ties break on distance from the viewport centre
playback.precedence: a deliberate hover or focus outranks scroll position when both are live
playback.gateNote: Never gate input on a media query here. (pointer: coarse) describes the primary pointer, so touch laptops, iPad in desktop mode and an open device toolbar lose hover entirely and fall through to an observer running against a non-scrolling row. (hover: hover) is a better guess but still a guess; the event is ground truth. The single remaining query asks about layout only.
playback.reducedMotion: poster only, never autoplay, no active scale - but the colour reveal still resolves

mediaMeta.captions: none; each tile is a button with an aria-label

contrastMeta.exemption: Disabled and decorative text, e.g. the calendar's outside days at /30

skipLink.focused: secondary button treatment, fixed top-4 left-6, above the nav stacking context
skipLink.why: Eleven tab stops sit between the logo and the booking form; WCAG 2.4.1 requires a bypass. tabIndex=-1 is required or focus stays behind while only the viewport scrolls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action in a view, using the approved cool two-stop gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(105deg, var(--color-ultraviolet) 0%, var(--color-violet) 100%); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 16px 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: filter 150ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-magenta); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action with a square hairline frame.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-fg); padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.30); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--color-fg); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-magenta); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Interactive Chip - Resting
components.description: The only chip family a user can act on. Colour signals interactivity; currently just the budget selector.
components.css: .ds-chip-resting { background: oklch(0.78 0.19 280 / 0.12); color: var(--color-violet); padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.78 0.19 280 / 0.45); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip-resting:hover { background: oklch(0.78 0.19 280 / 0.20); } .ds-chip-resting:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-magenta); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Interactive Chip - Selected
components.description: The selected state, always solid Violet rather than a gradient.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--color-violet); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-violet); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-chip-selected:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-chip-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-magenta); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Location Autocomplete
components.description: An assisted venue, city, and address field with full-width helper copy, a square Black suggestion list, Violet active option, one compact OpenStreetMap and Geoapify credit, and manual-entry fallback.
components.css: .ds-location { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 10px; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.50); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-location input { background: transparent; color: var(--color-fg); padding: 0 0 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-magenta); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-location [role=listbox] { position: absolute; inset: 100% 0 auto; background: var(--color-bg); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.65); } .ds-location [role=option] { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--color-violet); color: var(--color-ink); border: 0; text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-location small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; opacity: 0.65; } .ds-location-credit { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-location-credit a { color: inherit; } .ds-location-helper { width: 100%; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: The transparent booking field with a Magenta focus underline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 10px; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.50); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; background: transparent; color: var(--color-fg); padding: 0 0 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); border-radius: 0; outline: 0; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-bottom-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.30); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: var(--color-magenta); }

components.name: Interactive Chip - Selected
components.description: A 44px calendar cell showing default, hover, focus, and selected behavior.
components.css: .ds-calendar-day { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--color-violet); color: var(--color-ink); border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-calendar-day:hover { background: var(--color-violet); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-calendar-day:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.78 0.19 320 / 0.70); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Fixed square-edged navigation with a simplified mark and one dominant booking action.
components.html: KNWLDGEVENTSMUSICBOOK
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; padding: 16px 24px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.10); color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-nav-mark { margin-right: auto; color: var(--color-magenta); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-fg); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-magenta); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-book { background: linear-gradient(105deg, var(--color-ultraviolet) 0%, var(--color-violet) 100%); color: var(--color-ink) !important; padding: 8px 18px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Footer Contact Actions
components.description: One responsive footer plane with a gradient logo and four Violet-icon contact actions. The complete action group stacks below the logo before individual actions may wrap.

components.css: .ds-unified-footer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 20px; background: var(--color-bg); } .ds-unified-footer nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 0 24px; } .ds-unified-footer a { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0 8px; color: var(--color-fg); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-unified-footer .violet { color: var(--color-violet); } .ds-unified-footer a:hover { color: var(--color-violet); } .ds-unified-footer a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-magenta); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-unified-footer nav { flex-wrap: nowrap; } } @media (min-width: 900px) { .ds-unified-footer { flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; } .ds-unified-footer nav { justify-content: flex-end; } }

components.name: Open-Format Field
components.description: The square signature panel that carries the complete five-stop palette.
components.css: .ds-open-format { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 280px) 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 48px; padding: 56px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--color-ultraviolet) 0%, var(--color-violet) 24%, var(--color-orchid) 50%, var(--color-magenta) 76%, var(--color-rose) 100%); color: var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0; } .ds-open-format h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 400; } .ds-open-format div { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; } .ds-open-format span { padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.30); border-radius: 9999px; color: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
KNWLDG is a black performance space cut by controlled light. The visual system is electric, disciplined, and crowd-aware: strong type establishes the beat, square geometry creates structure, and the five-color ramp supplies movement without becoming generic nightlife decoration.

The system balances club energy with the clarity required by wedding, corporate, festival, and private-event clients. It rejects soft wedding-template styling, undirected neon, and corporate card stacks. Every section should communicate one idea with a strict grid, deliberate spacing, and enough black space for the accents to feel like light.
keyCharacteristics: Black stage, white information, five spectral accents.
Square-edged surfaces and disciplined grid seams.
Anton display type paired with Sora body and UI type.
Full-palette energy used in named, repeatable roles.
Flat content hierarchy with one functional floating shadow.
Choreographed hero motion and restrained motion everywhere else.

rules.name: The Full Ramp Has a Job Rule
rules.body: The five-stop sequence is Ultraviolet, Violet, Orchid, Magenta, Rose. Use it for the square open-format field, the favicon, and explicitly documented full-ramp treatments only.

rules.name: The Role-Based Gradient Rule
rules.body: Primary buttons use Ultraviolet, Violet. Brand marks use Violet, Magenta. The unassigned variation is Magenta, Rose. Never improvise a new sequence when an approved role already exists.

rules.name: The Ink on Light Rule
rules.body: Text on solid accents and gradients is always Black. White text on a bright ramp is forbidden.

rules.name: The Two-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Black and White are the complete neutral palette. Create hierarchy with opacity, not extra gray or tinted-neutral tokens.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Anton displays. Sora reads and operates. A third typeface is forbidden without a system-level reason.

rules.name: The Short-Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase and tracking belong to headlines and short UI labels. Paragraphs remain sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: A surface receives a shadow only when it genuinely floats over another interaction layer. If a content card has a shadow, the hierarchy is wrong.

rules.name: The One Icon Library Rule
rules.body: Icons come from Lucide at 20px / 1.75 stroke. A second icon library is forbidden - mixing sets puts two optical grids and two stroke weights on one page. Icons are decorative; adjacent text carries the meaning, so every icon is aria-hidden.

rules.name: The Colour Means Interactive Rule
rules.body: Chips split into two semantic families. Interactive chips carry Violet and a selected state; they are the only ones a user can act on. Static chips are read-only labels, monotone with a faint border so a long row reads as one texture rather than as buttons. Choose static (on black) or static-light (on the open-format field) by the surface, not by meaning. A static chip never gains a hover, focus, or selected state.

rules.name: The Brand Mark Exception
rules.body: Lucide ships no brand icons, so third-party marks (Instagram) come from that brand's own guidelines rather than being redrawn in Lucide's style. Draw them at the same 20px / 1.75 stroke, and inline them: currentColor only inherits when the SVG is part of the document.

rules.name: The One Overlap Rule
rules.body: The capabilities media strip is the only place surfaces overlap; everywhere else keeps strict 1px seams and flat planes. The overlap makes a mixed set of archival photos and modern clips read as one collection, and it earns the only shadow permitted outside the calendar popover, because without a cast edge the overlap is invisible. Do not carry overlap into cards, grids, or sections.

rules.name: The Muted Text Floor
rules.body: text-fg/50 (5.28:1 on black) is the lowest opacity permitted for normal text. /45 measures 4.41:1 and /40 measures 3.66:1; both fail WCAG 1.4.3. The Two-Neutral Rule says to build hierarchy with opacity but never set a limit, and that gap produced four real contrast failures. Disabled and decorative text is exempt.

dos: **Do** use Black, White, and the five named accent colors only.
**Do** preserve the approved gradient roles and stop order.
**Do** use square geometry for panels, buttons, fields, cards, and floating surfaces; chips alone use fully rounded pill geometry.
**Do** keep each section focused on one decision or proof point.
**Do** keep the `1440px` content cap and use the `900px` content breakpoint before inventing another.
**Do** use 1px shared seams for repeated content grids.
**Do** maintain 4.5:1 text contrast, visible focus states, 44px touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** verify the animated hero in a GPU-backed browser across multiple frames.
donts: **Don't** use soft, rounded wedding-template styling beyond the intentional pill shape of chips.
**Don't** dilute the established square-edged, dark, magenta-to-violet identity.
**Don't** introduce gray, cream, tinted-neutral, or unrelated accent colors.
**Don't** use gradients for text or selected chips.
**Don't** add decorative card shadows, glassmorphism, or rounded containers.
**Don't** reuse the hero's beat-synced or WebGL effects elsewhere on the page.
**Don't** animate width, height, top, left, or any property that triggers layout.
**Don't** raise the laser flash rate above 3Hz.
